payload.title: Grok Bot adapter (later source)
payload.description:
Purpose: add Grok Bot (a desktop AI assistant app) conversations as a required later source, via its own adapter conforming to the shared normalized record.

Scope: research Grok Bot's conversation storage on macOS (app container paths, database or file formats, session and authorship semantics) — nothing is assumed from the other adapters; capture fixture data from a real Mac locally; implement discovery and human-message extraction per the adapter contract; dedup, incremental re-scan, and doctor checks consistent with the other sources.

Done when: the research is recorded (with citations or clearly marked assumptions); golden extraction tests pass on synthetic fixtures; Grok Bot sessions appear in the meter counts alongside the other sources; privacy rules apply identically.
